name: qoder
label: Qoder CLI
description: Qoder's terminal coding agent (qoder.com), driven headless
tagline: Qoder's terminal coding agent, on a Qoder account sign-in or a personal access token. Installed by Qoder's own script.

check_ready.not_ready_message: Not signed in — sign in with `qodercli login` (it opens a browser), or paste a personal access token from https://qoder.com/account/integrations (press e). A Qoder CN (qoder.cn) account belongs to the qoder-cn agent instead.

env_config.name: QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
env_config.description: Personal access token from https://qoder.com/account/integrations. Leave blank to use the account signed in with `qodercli login` on this machine; a token set here always takes precedence over that sign-in.

env_config.name: QODER_MODEL
env_config.description: Model for each run — auto, lite, performance, or a key from `qodercli --list-models`. Leave blank for the account default. Other providers' API keys do not work here: models come from the Qoder account.
